proposal_text: How can qualitative speech be quantified using BoW features?
operational_definition: Generate tokenized speech utterances, compute BoW scores, validate predictive value, and test guarded live integration.
main_hypotheses: BoW features can quantify speech; predictive value should not be assumed to imply live policy value.
main_result: BoW quantified speech and achieved moderate prediction, but OOD and live-policy failures prevent deployment as a primary decision policy.
limitations: Template-generated speech and no human dialogue corpus.

proposal_text: What payoff-maximizing strategies are supported for each role within the tested strategy space?
operational_definition: Use R5.1/R6/R6.1 actor-specific matched contrasts and R6.2 metric audits to recommend tested policies.
main_hypotheses: Role-specific policies differ in faction win rate, actor payoff, and risk exposure.
main_result: Villager trust-weighted voting is strongly supported; several harmful policies are rejected; some Seer and Witch candidates remain uncertain.
limitations: Strongest tested policies are not global optima.

proposal_text: How can Werewolf decisions be interpreted using payoff, risk, opportunity cost, and financial-market analogy?
operational_definition: Apply the frozen R4 payoff ledger and R5 risk metrics to role and strategy outcomes.
main_hypotheses: Expected payoff and downside-risk metrics reveal different role and strategy tradeoffs.
main_result: Werewolf has the highest mean and risk-adjusted payoff; Hunter has the worst tail risk; financial analogy is bounded.
limitations: Game payoff analogues are not real financial returns.

proposal_text: Do predictive models improve live policy outcomes?
operational_definition: Compare predictive/shadow ML and BoW results against matched live complete-game policy deployment.
main_hypotheses: Predictive or shadow value may fail under live feedback and distribution shift.
main_result: Predictive accuracy and shadow value did not justify live deployment; ML remains diagnostic only.
limitations: Evaluated frozen standard-library models, not the full space of ML policies.

proposal_text: How robust are conclusions to seed, regime, seat order, direction, and information leakage?
operational_definition: Use multi-seed, regime, randomized-role, label-neutral, mirror replay, leakage, and overfitting audits.
main_hypotheses: Apparent position or model effects may disappear under stricter validation.
completed_stages: randomized role; structured search; seat-order neutral; physical replay; R6.1;R6.2;R7.1
main_result: Engine symmetry and DOI/documentation validation passed; positional folklore was unsupported after randomization.

proposal_text: Which early findings survive stricter grouped, matched, and live-policy validation?
operational_definition: Apply evidence priority to supersede pilot, shadow, proxy, and global-label claims where later evidence is stronger.
main_hypotheses: Some early descriptive gains will not survive grouped or matched live validation.
main_result: Pilot ML and BoW predictive claims are qualified by live failures; R5 global labels are superseded by actor-specific attribution.
limitations: Some historical datasets lack event-level reconstruction.
